user.title: Connect MyQ
user.description: Enter your MyQ email, password, and debug token. If MyQ asks for a verification code, you will be prompted next. Your password and debug token are not saved.

data_description.debug_token: Paste the debug token value or its JSON line/object. Leave blank to use an installed myq_app_check.json.

browser.title: Sign in with a browser
browser.description:
MyQ needs this sign-in to be completed in a web browser.

1. [Open the MyQ sign-in page]({authorize_url}) in a browser on a computer and sign in with {email}. On a phone with the MyQ app, the app may open instead.
2. When sign-in finishes, the browser tries to open an address that starts with `com.myqops://android`. Copy the complete address and paste it below.

If the address isn't shown, open the browser's developer tools (F12 in Chrome or Edge) and copy it from the Console message that starts with `Failed to launch 'com.myqops://android?`. The link works once and expires after 10 minutes.

data_description.callback: The complete com.myqops://android address, or the whole Console message that contains it.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect MyQ
reauth_confirm.description: Your MyQ session could not be renewed. Sign in to the same account again. Your password and debug token are not saved.

data_description.debug_token: Paste the debug token value or its JSON line/object. Leave blank to use an installed myq_app_check.json.

finish.title: Finish connecting MyQ
finish.description: Sign-in completed, but account or device discovery failed. Submit to retry discovery using the same session.

error.invalid_auth: MyQ rejected the credentials or session. Check your account details and start again if the verification session expired.
error.invalid_code: Verification was not completed. Check the code and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to MyQ. Try again later.
error.access_denied: MyQ denied this request. App verification or additional account permissions may be required.
error.app_verification: MyQ rejected verification of the application (401.122).
error.unsupported_auth: MyQ presented a sign-in or verification screen this integration does not yet support. See the protocol notes; this may require an app verification token or a new MFA form.
error.rate_limited: MyQ has limited requests. Wait before trying again.
error.protocol_error: MyQ returned an unexpected response. Check the integration's protocol notes. No account was added.
error.browser_verification: MyQ requires a browser verification step that this integration cannot complete.
error.invalid_callback: This isn't the address from the sign-in link shown here. Paste the complete address that starts with com.myqops://android.
error.browser_expired: The sign-in link expired. Open the new link and sign in again.
error.browser_auth_failed: MyQ did not accept this sign-in. Open the new link and sign in again.
error.app_check_unavailable: Could not obtain app verification from Firebase. Check the connection and registration, then try again.
error.app_check_expired: The app verification provider returned an expiring token. Try again.
error.app_check_invalid: The debug token, app verification configuration, or returned token is invalid.
error.app_check_integrity: Firebase rejected the debug token or app registration.
error.app_check_not_configured: Enter a debug token, or install myq_app_check.json in your Home Assistant configuration directory.
error.app_check_config_unreadable: Home Assistant cannot read myq_app_check.json. Check its file permissions in the configuration directory.
error.app_check_config_invalid: myq_app_check.json is invalid. Check the registration configuration in the sign-in guide.

abort.already_configured: This MyQ account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Sign in to the same MyQ account as the existing integration.
abort.invalid_auth: This MyQ session was rejected. Start a new sign-in.

get_accessories.description: Read paired opener accessories and enable their battery diagnostics for this loaded integration. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

rename_accessory.name: Rename accessory
rename_accessory.description: Rename a paired accessory (1 to 24 characters, not already used on that opener) and wait for reported confirmation. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

accessory_serial.description: Select an existing accessory from get_accessories.

remove_accessory.name: Remove accessory
remove_accessory.description: Remove a paired accessory and wait for confirmed absence. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

accessory_serial.name: Accessory serial
accessory_serial.description: Select an existing accessory from get_accessories.

set_auto_relock.name: Set auto relock
set_auto_relock.description: Set supported legacy lock auto relock and wait for reported confirmation. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

seconds.name: Delay
seconds.description: Native auto relock delay in seconds.

get_schedules.description: Read schedules for an existing camera feature configuration. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

set_schedule_enabled.description: Enable or disable an existing camera workflow schedule and confirm the change. A schedule cannot be enabled while it overlaps another enabled schedule of the same feature. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

save_schedule.description: Add or update a camera workflow schedule and confirm reported completion. Without a configuration ID, create the first supported feature configuration only when none exists. An enabled schedule cannot overlap another enabled schedule of the same feature. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

configuration_id.description: Existing configuration ID. Omit only to create the first supported feature configuration.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: Existing schedule ID; omit when adding a schedule.

days.name: Days
days.description: Weekdays in the existing configuration time zone.

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: Local time in HH:mm:00 format; different from start.

delete_schedule.name: Delete schedule
delete_schedule.description: Delete an existing camera workflow schedule and confirm absence. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

feature.name: Camera feature

configuration_id.name: Configuration ID

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: Existing schedule ID; omit when adding a schedule.

get_pins.name: Get pins
get_pins.description: Read remote lock PIN names, IDs, access and status. Numeric PINs are never returned. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

save_pin.name: Save pin
save_pin.description: Create or update a remote lock PIN from a private local file and wait for synced status. The integration does not retain the PIN; remove the file after use. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name for the existing accessory or PIN.

pin_file.name: Private PIN file
pin_file.description: Name of a JSON file directly in the HA config directory, with the digits under the key "pin"; owned by HA and readable only by its owner. Only this filename enters the service bus.

pin_id.name: PIN ID
pin_id.description: Existing ID from get_pins; omit to add.

delete_pin.name: Delete pin
delete_pin.description: Delete a remote lock PIN and wait for confirmed absence. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

pin_id.name: PIN ID
pin_id.description: Existing ID from get_pins; omit to add.

get_guests.name: Get guests
get_guests.description: Read existing MyQ guests and their allowed-device schedules. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

set_guest_devices.name: Set guest devices
set_guest_devices.description: Replace an existing guest schedule device list while preserving its time restrictions. Only device types the MyQ app lets you share are accepted. Taking a video keypad away does not delete the guest's PIN on it; remove that in the app first. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

allowed_serials.name: Allowed device serials
allowed_serials.description: Existing devices in the same MyQ account. An empty list removes all device access for this schedule.

remove_guest.name: Remove guest
remove_guest.description: Revoke an existing guest and confirm absence. Owners and co-owners cannot be removed by this action. Unlike the MyQ app, this does not delete the guest's keypad PINs first; remove those in the app beforehand. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

assign_accessory.name: Assign accessory
assign_accessory.description: Assign a paired accessory to an existing guest who already has access to the opener. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

accessory_serial.name: Accessory serial
accessory_serial.description: Select an existing accessory from get_accessories.

set_auto_lock.name: Set auto lock
set_auto_lock.description: Configure automatic locking on a supported native Wi-Fi lock. Zero disables it; supported delays are 30, 60, 90, 120, 180 seconds. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

seconds.name: Delay
seconds.description: Delay in seconds before the lock locks itself; 0 turns automatic locking off.

set_door_sensor.name: Set door sensor
set_door_sensor.description: Enable or disable a configured, calibrated native Wi-Fi lock door sensor and confirm reported state. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

rename_device.name: Rename device
rename_device.description: Rename a MyQ device in the MyQ account (up to 24 characters, as in the app) and confirm the new name. Account owner only. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

get_device_history.name: Get device history
get_device_history.description: Return one page of the device's MyQ activity history, oldest first: what happened, when, and by whom. User identifiers are omitted. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

continuation.name: Continuation
continuation.description: Continuation value from a previous response, to read the next page.

get_alerts.name: Get alerts
get_alerts.description: Return the device's MyQ notification rules and whether each is enabled. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

snooze_alerts.name: Snooze alerts
snooze_alerts.description: Snooze all MyQ notifications for the device's account for a number of minutes. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

cancel_alert_snooze.name: Cancel alert snooze
cancel_alert_snooze.description: End an active MyQ notification snooze for the device's account. Requires a Home Assistant administrator.

get_thermostat_programs.name: Get thermostat programs
get_thermostat_programs.description: Return a linked thermostat's presets and schedules (read only). Requires a Home Assistant administrator.
